name: Farrukh Ahmad
contribution: Farrukh Ahmad was a Bengali poet whose Islamic imagery and moral concerns gave Muslim literary modernism a distinctive voice.
context: Writing across late-colonial Bengal, Pakistan-period East Bengal, and early Bangladesh, he combined classical allusion with modern Bengali poetic form.
impact: His work is essential to understanding the diverse religious and civilisational imaginations within modern Bengali literature.
highlight: A major poet of Bengali Muslim civilizational imagination.
seoTitle: Farrukh Ahmad: Bengali Muslim Literary Modernism
seoDescription: Explore Farrukh Ahmad's poetry, Islamic literary modernism, and place in Bengali Muslim cultural history.
shortAnswer: Farrukh Ahmad was a Bengali poet who combined Islamic themes, moral critique, and modern literary form.
